name: block-catalog
prompt: Add the block type catalog for the block placement system: one module that lists the five block types players can place (brick, dirt, grass, window, wood) with the color, material, and transparency each one uses. Server and client code will both read it. Only the catalog for now; the placement system and the UI come later.

checks.text: A Luau file under src lists the Window and Wood block types
The catalog is frozen with table.freeze

rubric: Lists all five block types, each with a color, a material, and a transparency
Sits where both server and client code can require it
Typed, idiomatic Luau that is easy to extend with a new block type
Stays in scope: no placement system or UI
